paper.title_en: Galactic constraints on spinning primordial black hole dark matter from interstellar dust heating
paper.abstract_en: Primordial black holes (PBHs) are compelling dark matter candidates. PBHs with masses between $10^{15}$ and $10^{18}\,\mathrm{g}$ can heat interstellar dust via Hawking radiation. Previous studies of this dust heating mechanism mostly neglected PBH spin and adopted a single dark matter halo profile. In this work, we incorporate PBH spin, which substantially enhances the emitted radiation flux, and systematically investigate the dependence of constraints on the dark matter density distribution by considering five different halo models. We compute the complete photon spectra, including both primary and secondary emissions. Our results show that, for a fixed profile and mass function, larger spin parameters yield stronger constraints on the PBH fraction $f_{\mathrm{PBH}}$. Among the halo models, the Isothermal profile gives the most stringent limits, followed by Einasto, then NFW and Moore, while the Burkert profile yields the weakest constraints. For silicate grains, which cool less efficiently than graphite, the upper limits reach $\mathcal{O}(10^{-4})$ for high spin cases. We consider both monochromatic and lognormal mass functions, and find consistent trends between them. For the lognormal case, larger values of the width $σ$ lead to a broader mass range being excluded, in particular ruling out massive PBHs as the sole dark matter component. Our bounds are generally weaker than other existing limits, but they provide a complementary and independent constraint.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文将原始黑洞自旋纳入霍金辐射加热星际尘埃的计算，并系统比较五种暗物质晕模型，对光子谱及质量函数作了扩展，属于黑洞热力学与霍金辐射应用的前沿课题；虽约束弱于其他限制，但提供了独立补充。综合理论深度、方法严谨性、新颖性和清晰度，建议点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 来自星际尘埃加热的旋转原初黑洞暗物质的银河系约束
decision.abstract_zh: 原初黑洞（PBHs）是引人注目的暗物质候选者。质量在 $10^{15}$ 至 $10^{18}\,\mathrm{g}$ 之间的PBHs可以通过霍金辐射加热星际尘埃。以往对这种尘埃加热机制的研究大多忽略了PBH自旋，并采用单一的暗物质晕轮廓。在这项工作中，我们纳入了PBH自旋，这显著增强了发射的辐射通量，并通过考虑五种不同的晕模型，系统地研究了约束对暗物质密度分布的依赖性。我们计算了完整的光子谱，包括初级和次级发射。我们的结果表明，对于固定的轮廓和质量函数，较大的自旋参数对PBH比例 $f_{\mathrm{PBH}}$ 产生更强的约束。在晕模型中，等温轮廓给出最严格的限制，其次是Einasto，然后是NFW和Moore，而Burkert轮廓给出最弱的约束。对于冷却效率低于石墨的硅酸盐颗粒，在高自旋情况下，上限达到 $\mathcal{O}(10^{-4})$。我们考虑了单色和对数正态质量函数，并发现它们之间趋势一致。对于对数正态情况，较大的宽度 $σ$ 值导致更广泛的质量范围被排除，特别是排除了大质量PBHs作为唯一暗物质成分的可能性。我们的界限通常弱于其他现有极限，但它们提供了互补且独立的约束。
